content: .{@-प्रशंसा@} a figure of speech which, by describing the अप्रस्तुत (what is not the subject-matter) conveys a reference to the प्रस्तुत or subject-matter; अप्रस्तुतप्रशंसा सा या सैव प्रस्तुताश्रया <ls>K. P. 10</ls>. It is of 5 kinds:-- कार्ये निमित्ते सामान्ये विशेषे प्रस्तुते सति . तदन्यस्य वचस्तुल्ये तुल्यस्येति च पञ्चधा .. {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} when the subject-matter is viewed .³({%a%}) as an effect, information of which is conveyed by stating the cause; .³({%b%}) when viewed as a cause by stating the effect; .³({%c%}) when viewed as a general assertion by stating a particular instance; .³({%d%}) when viewed as a particular instance by stating a general assertion; and .³({%e%}) when viewed as similar by stating what is similar to it. See <ls>K. P. 10</ls> and <ls>S. D. 706</ls> for examples.
